page.overview:
Who is Tomeytine?

is an honesty earth pony. He was played by Liam O'Brien.

Tomeytine is an earth pony with a pale orange coat, bright orange mane, and blue-green eyes. His cutie mark is an open book. He wear large round glasses.

Tomeytine likes books and is very good at studying. He tends to hyperfixate on things.

Tomeytine: I'm an earth pony, and I've burned no parents.
